column7: Modern oak roll-top desk, big/heavy (2+ people), value <$500 so size rule kills
Yard sale table (Funko, Hot Wheels, LEGO boxes); no specific item, $0 is placeholder, nothing valued
~38 lb mixed LEGO + built botanical set; bulk sells ~$6-9/lb (closo.co) = ~$230-340 vs $125 ask, not 3x
12 carded Star Wars POTF/Ep I figures, mostly common characters ~$5-8 each; ~$60-90 total, priced at value

Large lot of ~30 used DeWalt/Makita/Milwaukee/Ridgid tools incl. Ridgid framing nailer, Milwaukee hammer drill/saws, Makita jigsaw; used lots of this kind resell $300-600 (estimate, eBay power tool lots). Ask what price really is ($1 placeholder); test each tool, check batteries/chargers included, no cracked housings
Shure MV7X USB/XLR dynamic mic; used $99 Reverb / $178 Amazon like-new (equipboard), Guitar Center used listings; conservative $100. Check XLR/USB cable included, mount arm, works on both outputs
Dusty 1940s console radio cabinet + tabletop radio; consoles almost unsellable, big, rough

Mix of Pokemon in slabs/hard cases: Japanese M Charizard EX full art (XY Evolutions equiv; EN raw NM ~$138 pokeinvesting), Altaria ex, Sylveon V, Mewtwo, gold Rayquaza-type card; estimate. At $1 ask low risk. Check authenticity (gold card looks fake), whether PSA-certified (verify cert), card names/set numbers
Modern base/2024 rookie football cards (Scoring/Contenders/Prestige), no stars/autos visible; $100 ask >= value
Mega Gengar ex Mega Battle Deck + Pitch Black booster bundle; retail ~$25-35 each, ~$50-60 total resale
Chevron amethyst sphere ~3in on stand; typically $30-60 sold, priced at value
Empty Tom's snack vending display shelf cabinet (no coin mech visible), not a machine; ~$50-100, needs notice 44mi
Chinese simplified 30th Celebration cards (Pikachu GX, Solgaleo GX, gold Crystal card): common Chinese cards, ~$5-15 each, likely fan/CGC-less; low value
Free Pokemon: tin of bulk cards, Rayquaza tin, few ex in sleeves; bulk worth ~$30-60 (estimate), 40mi
Beanie Babies lot; mostly common, 'The End' and Diana bears ~$10-20 sold; tagged rares unseen; ~$50 ask at value
Long box of 2014 Prizm football base cards, mostly commons ($0.10-0.25) ~$40-80 estimate; 44mi

~10 factory-sealed 2026 Topps Neon Marvel Mega boxes; retail $49.99 Best Buy, eBay sealed asks $69-75 each (cardsmithsbreaks); conservative sold ~$35+ each = ~$350 for $75 total (estimate, no sold data found). Verify sealed shrink, mega (not value) boxes, count 10
2021 Day of the Dead Forever stamps, 100/set face ~$75, resells ~$60-65; need multiple sets for $100, ask per set. Only worth if buying 2+
Rusty cast iron pitcher pump parts + steel wagon seat, heavy, ~$30-80 sold
Raw matrix turquoise chunk ~3in, unidentified mine, ~$20-50; no provenance
Luka Doncic lot: 2018 Chronicles RC (base ~$30-60 PSA9), Select Concourse blue, a slabbed Luka/Trae insert; sportscardspro shows only parallels at $190+; conservative ~$130 vs $80 ask, not 3x
1950s Emerson 3-blade cage fan, rusty paint, appears untested; sells ~$50-100, priced at value
Free Stanley kidney executive desk, very heavy multi-person; value <$500, 26mi
LEGO storage head with bulk bricks (~8 lb), ~$50-70 at $6-9/lb, priced at value
